case_number: 2023 INSC 861; Civil Appeal No.  of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 8428 OF 2018)
summary: Property ownership dispute; gift-deed validity under undue influence; sale-deed validity confirmed; appeal against High Court's revision modifying decree; Section 115 CPC jurisdictional limits; no right to appeal against review rejection; revisional powers for jurisdictional errors; contradictory trial court judgment; error apparent on record; no merger of review with appealable decree; revision maintainable for review rejection.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; review rejection corrected via revision; trial court decree modified; respondent's exclusive ownership confirmed.
